_comment: Curated root causes for scripts/app-suite --app writebook. Unpassed tests are
clustered mechanically by failure message; this file is what turns a cluster
into a named todo with an owner. Rules are tried in order; FIRST MATCH WINS,
so the specific ones sit above the general ones.
`match` keys on the failure MESSAGE. A rule may add `match_test`, keyed on
the test identifier, and then both have to hold — which is the only way to
name a SILENT divergence, since every wrong answer reads as the same
assertion failure.
The unit is an UNPASSED TEST, not a FAIL line: a file that dies at load
contributes its whole count against its load error. See the header of
scripts/app-suite-summary.
The first rules come from the first joined run (2026-11-16). The
`constant not supported` rules key on `match_frame`, where the emitted
raise ran (the `  at` line): the message does not name the constant.
owner:
compiler — roundhouse modeling debt. Ours to fix.
app      — a Writebook idiom that could change upstream. Only ever a
plain-Rails change that stands on its own merits under stock
Rails; the port never asks for app-side divergence.
gem      — a gem whose surface we shim, or one deliberately out of scope.
spinel   — upstream spinel.
harness  — this harness's own gap, not the emit's.
subset   — the test reaches for dynamic Ruby no compiled target has
(a per-object `extend`, `define_method`, `eval`). Nobody
can act: not a todo, named so it is not triaged twice, and
left out of the who-can-act line.
unknown  — the cluster is real, its root cause is not yet known.

causes.title: `Rails::Html::FullSanitizer`, `Rails::Html::WhiteListSanitizer` and Loofah's safe lists are not modeled
causes.note: Leaf::Searchable strips HTML with `Rails::Html::FullSanitizer.new.sanitize`; HtmlScrubber builds its allow-lists from `Rails::Html::WhiteListSanitizer.allowed_tags` and `Loofah::HTML5::SafeList::ACCEPTABLE_ATTRIBUTES`. Each emits a raise, so search, positioning and the scrubber all stop there.

causes.title: `ActiveSupport::Digest` is not modeled
causes.note: EmbedProvider's cache version is `ActiveSupport::Digest.hexdigest` over the providers' signatures.

causes.title: `delegated_type` answers the id, not the record
causes.match: Leafable must exist|'(book|slug|leafable_name|searchable_content)' for (an instance of Integer|nil)
causes.note: Leaf and Edit declare `delegated_type :leafable`. The emitted reader answers the integer id, so the required check fails ("Leafable must exist") and `leaf.leafable.book` is sent to an Integer.

causes.title: The attachment proxy API (`last`, `id`, `blobs`) and `attachment_reflections`
causes.note: `has_many_attached` answers an AttachedMany without `last`/`blobs`, `has_one_attached` one without `id`, and the class has no `attachment_reflections`.

causes.title: `ApplicationController.helpers`, the view-helper proxy
causes.note: Models and jobs render through `ApplicationController.helpers`; the class method is missing.

causes.title: `to_signed_global_id` and `Rails.application.key_generator`
causes.note: Upload URLs carry signed global ids, QR links sign with the app's key generator.

causes.title: Association `insert_all` / `upsert_all`
causes.note: `accesses.insert_all(rows)` on a has_many answers the loaded Array instead of the association's bulk insert.

causes.title: Permitted params lack Hash methods (`reject`, `with_defaults`)
causes.note: A permitted params object is a struct-like class without the Hash API the controller calls.

causes.title: The SQLite raw connection API (`raw_connection.changes`)
causes.note: Leaf::Searchable maintains its FTS index with raw SQL and reads `connection.raw_connection.changes`; the emitted raw connection has no `changes`.

causes.title: `URI::Generic#request_uri`
causes.note: EmbedProvider builds request paths with `URI(url).request_uri`; the emitted URI is a URI::Generic.

causes.title: The redcarpet renderer and `ERB::Util.html_escape_once`
causes.note: Markdown rendering goes through redcarpet with a Rouge plugin; neither the gem's renderer nor `html_escape_once` is modeled.

causes.title: A test that shells out to `bin/rails`
causes.note: RedisCacheStoreTest boots the production config through `bin/rails runner`; the emit has no bin/rails.
